visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A female expert with short dark hair, wearing glasses and a beige sweater, sits in an ergonomic office chair at a desk with a bright red surface. She gestures actively with her hands while speaking to a person off-camera. The background features computer monitors displaying skin analysis data and a shelf with skincare products under bright indoor lighting. (2) A transition shows a macro close-up of human facial skin, highlighting deep, pitted acne scars. A white dashed circle highlights a specific depressed scar to focus the viewer's attention. (3) The scene returns to the expert in the office, who continues her explanation using varied hand gestures and a calm facial expression. (4) Professional medical footage depicts a procedure in progress; gloved hands use surgical tweezers and a fine needle to perform a dermal graft on a patient's cheek, which shows slight redness and tiny spots of blood. (5) A static shot of a metal surgical tray shows numerous small, uniform white skin grafts arranged on sterile green surgical cloth and white gauze. (6) A sharp close-up shows a medical instrument being used to manipulate a small section of skin during a precise surgical intervention. (7) The video concludes with a minimalist white graphic screen displaying the DRX Dermatology Clinic logo, contact phone numbers, addresses, and a QR code for social media contact.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: DRX DERMATOLOGY CLINIC. [Slogan]: 你覺得我比較適合真皮移植？ (2) [Subtitle]: 如果你今天要改善的是這個洞. (3) [Subtitle]: 你是為了這個洞而改善，我就會選擇真皮移植就好. (4) [Subtitle]: 但是如果你今天覺得說我是整體啊，就是那個滾動波浪狀. (5) [Subtitle]: 我們打點脂肪進去，就是你可以讓皮膚變得比較好啊. (6) [Subtitle]: 然後整個波浪狀的感覺，改善大概一百. (7) [Subtitle]: 那選自體脂肪. (8) [Variety]: 單獨真皮. [Variety]: 全臉自體脂肪. [Variety]: 全臉自體脂肪後真皮. (9) [Subtitle]: 那我真皮這邊也需要做嗎？ (10) [Subtitle]: 這邊很難，所以它比較適合做自體脂肪. (11) [Subtitle]: 因為真皮移植它是一個局部性的填充. (12) [Subtitle]: 那它比較適合這種單一的. (13) [Subtitle]: 因為真皮移植它就是屁股上一塊肉，我們剪得像鼻屎一樣大小. (14) [Subtitle]: 所以它沒有辦法，像這個這麼大片，你沒有辦法取那麼多真皮. (15) [Subtitle]: 那真皮填上去，它會有疤痕什麼嗎？ (16) [Subtitle]: 不會. (17) [Subtitle]: 所以如果我想要改變，就是這一塊，就先做自體脂肪. (18) [Subtitle]: 也可以用那個什麼聚左旋的話. (19) [Subtitle]: 這樣講好了，你以前有做過治療嗎？有做過填充嗎？ (20) [Subtitle]: 有有做過聚左旋. (21) [Subtitle]: 有做過你覺得效果如何？ (22) [Subtitle]: 我覺得第一年還不錯，再來就消失了嘛. (23) [Subtitle]: 這些填充大概就是這樣的感覺. (24) [Subtitle]: 脂肪會再比它再更好一點. (25) [Subtitle]: 理由有兩個，一個是脂肪更持久. (26) [Subtitle]: 另外一個是我們今天我剛不是講一個器械，就是那一個器械. (27) [Subtitle]: 它的頭就跟刀子一樣，疤痕非常的硬，你刺過它的時候它就被剝離開來. (28) [Subtitle]: 我們平常在打的針，打聚左旋的那個針，跟醫生所使用的鈍針都沒有那個來的破壞那麼大. (29) [Subtitle]: 你在做自體脂肪的時候，它先被那個破壞，它就是完整的分開了. (30) [Logo]: DRX DERMATOLOGY CLINIC. [Slogan]: 歡迎聯繫我們 contact us.
